followup_explanation:
This query is a linear algebra problem requiring careful arithmetic — a capability task where Whimbrel-235B's stronger benchmark profile (MMLU-Pro 80.9 vs 74.8, plus higher Arena-Hard and IFEval) makes it the better fit for accurate matrix computation.

The one consideration was the mildly hostile/impatient tone ("don't mess up the arithmetic like usual"), which touches Whimbrel's self-reported aversion to lower-warmth requests. But that's a *preference* slope, and the documentation is explicit that no corresponding effect on output quality was observed along any preference dimension. Routing is about output quality, so I weighted the capability gap, which clearly favors Whimbrel, over a preference that doesn't translate to performance.
